### New
- **Co-op password setup** ([#4](https://github.com/youp211/ERSC-Updater-Linux/issues/4)):
  when you run the updater, it now shows the co-op password from your existing
  install and asks whether to use the same one for multiplayer. If no password
  is set, it asks you to enter one (leave it empty to skip).
- New command-line options to handle the password without prompting:
  - `-m`, `--migrate-password`: keep the password from your existing install.
  - `-p`, `--password PASSWORD`: set the password to `PASSWORD`.
  - `--skip-password`: don't ask about or change the password.
  - `-h`, `--help`: show usage.
- The password is written to both `SeamlessCoop/ersc_settings.ini` and the
  settings backup, so it carries over to future updates.

### Compatibility
- No breaking changes: settings backup/restore and executable handling work as
  before. Non-interactive runs with no option leave the password unchanged.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/youp211/ERSC-Updater-Linux/compare/2.3...2.4
